candidate.answerReason: Least squares selects a line minimizing the sum of squared residuals, which is choice A.

methods.label: Use the least squares criterion
methods.explanation: Each residual is squared before being added to avoid cancellation between positive and negative values. The line that minimizes this sum is the regression line.
methods.levelReason: The least squares definition and the sign properties of squares are within the introductory regression scope.
